content: The 2018 guideline on the management of blood cholesterol was developed by the American Heart Association (AHA) and the American College of Cardiology (ACC), in collaboration with multiple other professional organizations. This guideline provides evidence-based recommendations for the treatment and management of blood cholesterol levels to reduce the risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). The document, authored by Grundy SM, Stone NJ, Bailey AL, Beam C, Bircher KK, Blumenthal RS, and others, was published in 2019. It is titled 2018 AHA/ACC/AACVPR/AAPA/ABC/ACPM/ADA/AGS/APhA/ASPC/NLA/PCNA Guideline on the Management of Blood Cholesterol: Executive Summary. This report represents the work of the ACC/AHA Task Force on Clinical Practice Guidelines and was published in the Journal of the American College of Cardiology (JACC), Volume 73, Issue 24, pages 3168–3209.
